groups.interpretation: Retention flag takes precedence; trend flag chosen exact bullish otherwise bearish flag. Annotations are not runtime type validators.
Truthy selected trend flag: assert cursor None or _TrendLegCursor (assertions conditional); immediately delegate with initial and retain_initial=True. No separate cursor store here.

Otherwise assert nullable _InitialLegCursor, choose native bull or reflected bear.reference, run first_only with retention and supplied cursor. Copy helper._initial_cursor reference after successful scan, before reaction-list check.
Empty reactions returns None after cursor assignment; first result copied shallow for exact bullish, mirrored once otherwise (reflected reference route). No append or reset emission in this wrapper.

Nonretaining path ignores supplied cursor; exact bullish then flag routes bullish trend wrapper; exact bearish then flag routes bearish trend. Noncanonical direction does not qualify either trend guard.

Else choose native bull.detect or bear.detect first_only, return shallow replacement first reaction if list truthy else None. Native bear result already mirrored, no extra reflection. No explicit cursor clearing in wrapper.
Bullish bootstrap delegates exact bullish to RE82, default no retained cursor.
Start>end returns None before source/cursor access or cursor save. Declaration and explanatory docstring are not extra runtime admission.

Directional Boolean exact bullish; restore fixed_source reference if initial present else selected first main. Copy pending candidate shallow only when initial and candidate nonnull; restore next_index or start. No clamp or identity validation.
Traverse positional main indices inclusive through end, row lookup by sequence position.
While candidate absent, update fixed source on strict higher High bullish or lower Low otherwise. Equality retains earlier fixed reference. Includes potential First row before candidate formation.

Exact RED B/GREEN otherwise selects First; top fixed for B/current for other, bottom current for B/fixed for other. First index loop position, initial box source indices stored Candle.index, display fields from sources. Mode A boundary from original start Low B/High otherwise, not restored next index or fixed source. No prior boundary invalidation.
Continue consumes candidate creation row and every no-candidate row; cannot confirm on same First iteration.

With pending candidate, strict lower Low B or else nonbullish strict higher High updates opposite price/source; updated source index is loop position, display current candle. Equality retains ownership.

After update strict High>top B else Low<bottom confirms. Set Break loop position/display, invoke RE78 ignoring returned analysis, return candidate even if analysis absent. No new retained cursor save here, no append.
Only normal exhaustion and truthy retention save _TrendLegCursor(next=end+1,fixed_source,candidate) by reference; returns None. No cursor update for early empty window or successful confirmation.
Delegate direct reset search, return tuple element zero, discard pending flag. Docstring does not suppress later candidates when earlier candidate unresolved.
Derive context/First tags exact bullish else bearish, blocked_through starts reset_index; earlier_pending false.
Traverse First positions reset+1..end inclusive; read first row before blocked guard, skip position<=blocked_through. Wrong First tag short-circuits predecessor read; require adjacent context tag.
Build candidate with original reset and First, None skips; scan viable candidate to detector end via RE93; no global ordering by exact confirmation.
If confirmed nonnull return candidate plus current earlier_pending, even if previous candidate unresolved.

If unconfirmed with null invalidation, set sticky earlier_pending true and continue permitting later Firsts. Else set blocked_through to invalidation position, suppress First through inclusive boundary; no clearing of earlier_pending.
Exhaustion returns literal (None,True) even if no candidate ever pending; flag not a proof of unresolved specific candidate.

Limit end if request None else min(request,end); lookup (direction,reset,limit) membership including cached None. Hit returns shallow replace of candidate or None, before tags/search. No write in method.
Exact bullish tags otherwise bearish, recompute limit after miss, First ascending after reset inclusive to limit; current mismatch short circuits predecessor check. No local lower range clamp.
Build via same RE92 (local alignment still enforced), skip null; scan later main positions First+1..limit; no owner-boundary invalidation helper in this route.

Exact bullish strict lower Low update price/stored source fields then strict High>top sets Break stored Candle.index/display; RE78 return ignored, return candidate on first confirmation for this First.
Else strict higher High updates top/stored source then strict Low<bottom confirms, stored Break identity, refine then return. Unsupported direction follows else dispatch; native inputs assumed.
Exhaustion returns None. First traversal order determines selected complete geometry, not globally earliest exact confirmation. No local cache store of either outcome or ledger append.
Public wrapper forwards direction/reset/end unchanged, no extra validity/acceptance check.
Read requested direction ledger then inherited break-index cache. Nonnull cache and stored length==current len returns same cached list reference, no content equality, freshness, sorting or dedup.

On miss build list int(Break) in native ledger order; failed conversion precedes store. Store current length and list, return same list object; no automatic invalidation for equal-length mutations, caller must provide coherent ascending stream.

supplemental.historical: Retention path selects trend flag by exact bullish versus otherwise, validates cursor class via conditional assertions, and either directly delegates trend or uses bull/reflected bear reference scan; helper cursor assigned before null-result guard. Bearish ordinary candidate is mirrored from reference, not double-mirrored.

Nonretaining path checks exact bullish trend then exact bearish trend; otherwise uses bull or bear.detect first_only. Supplied cursor ignored on this route. Copy first native result, no further reflection.
Empty selected interval returns before reading source or retaining cursor. Restore fixed source and optional candidate copy; next index not clamped. Start/end inclusive.

Track strict directional confirmation-side extreme before First, equality retains existing fixed source. Mode A First at boundary allowed; candidate First index is loop position while box source indices come from Candle.index. Frozen boundary from original start. Continue consumes First without confirmation.

After First, strictly update opposite edge (source index is loop position, display from current candle), then strict confirmation; Break also loop position, refine and return. No owner-boundary invalidation. Normal exhaustion optionally saves next=end+1 with candidate reference; early returns do not save a new cursor.
Wrapper discards second tuple element; direct search carries earlier-pending information that caller may use separately.

First loop from Reset+1 inclusive; skip blocked positions and tag mismatch. Build local candidate then scan to full end; confirmed returns earlier_pending; no invalidation sets persistent earlier_pending true and continues; invalidation sets blocked_through. Exhaustion always returns null,true even without pending candidate. Docstring does not override actual later-candidate behavior.
Compute bounded limit for cache key; on hit clone candidate or return null. On miss compute limit again. No cache write within method, no assumption that other callers cannot populate it.

Geometry route checks adjacent tags and uses same direct builder (local eligibility still enforced), then scans First+1..limit inclusive. No owner invalidation check; strict opposite-edge update then strict confirmation sets Candle.index and display; refine return ignored; return first completed candidate in First traversal order, not earliest global confirmation.

Public wrapper delegates bound. Break cache is per direction with stored stream length only; int-convert each Break in existing order on miss, store list and return same list reference. No sorting, duplicate check, or mutation freshness check; append-only/monotonicity are caller invariants.

direct First traversal and blocked_through, sticky earlier_pending
geometry-only cache hit else local build and permissive scan

Historical B02-09/10 findings retained.

limitations: Local source semantics, not runtime equivalence or complete consumer admission. Source docstring about unresolved earlier owner is not unconditional; actual loop allows later candidates with earlier_pending true.
Geometry-only bypasses owner invalidation but not RE92 local admission. No universal ascending/duplicate-free cache guarantee.
